sessionStart.command: f=.designkit/scripts/hook.mjs; [ -f "$f" ] && command -v node >/dev/null 2>&1 || exit 0; node "$f" session-start --tool copilot

preToolUse.command: f=.designkit/scripts/hook.mjs; [ -f "$f" ] && command -v node >/dev/null 2>&1 || exit 0; node "$f" before-command --tool copilot

postToolUse.command: f=.designkit/scripts/hook.mjs; [ -f "$f" ] && command -v node >/dev/null 2>&1 || exit 0; node "$f" after-edit --tool copilot
